reasoning: As of March 6, 2026, there is no indication that the UK government has enacted or is about to enact legislation banning X/Twitter. While there have been tensions between Elon Musk and UK authorities over content moderation issues, particularly around the 2024 riots, banning a major social media platform would be an extreme measure unprecedented in Western democracies. The UK has regulatory frameworks like the Online Safety Act but these focus on compliance requirements, not outright bans. With only 25 days remaining until March 31, implementing such a dramatic ban is extremely unlikely.
